2105-5895-8201-8330.easyPrerequisites: Combat Celebrant hasn't been exerted this turn.
2105-5895-8201-8330.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
2105-5895-8201-8330.description:
Cast Massimo by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable.
When Massimo enters, it triggers, exiling Splash Portal from your graveyard and giving Massimo the listed ability.
Declare Massimo and Combat Celebrant as attackers, choosing to exert Combat Celebrant as it attacks.
Combat Celebrant triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Deal combat damage with Massimo. Its ability triggers, casting a copy of Splash Portal from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Splash Portal, blinking Combat Celebrant.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

574-6529-7084.description:
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing another nonland creature you control
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a 2/2 black Zombie creature token with decayed
Resolve Vish Kal's ability, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on them equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.
574-6529-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

813-2072-2320.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn or an opponent's upkeep.
Lands you control tap for enough to cast Reset and Scrollshift.
813-2072-2320.description:
Activate all your lands by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast your two spells.
Cast Reset by paying its mana cost, causing you to untap all lands you control.
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Scholar of the Ages and drawing a card, and putting Scrollshift into your graveyard as it resolves.
Scholar of the Ages triggers when it enters, returning Reset and Scrollshift to your hand.
Repeat.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

4550-5147-5567-7824--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
4550-5147-5567-7824--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4214-5189-5439-7824.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4214-5189-5439-7824.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Utopia Mycon's second ability by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-2919-5086-5183-7824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-2919-5086-5183-7824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

1368-3755-5434-6321.notablePrerequisites: You have at least three other cards in your graveyard.
1368-3755-5434-6321.description:
Cast Malevolent Rumble for its escape cost by paying {1}{G} and exiling three other cards from your graveyard, causing you to mill at least three cards and create a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

1903-4499-6723-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

1636-2734-5371-7629.description:
Animate Hourglass of the Lost using Cyberdrive Awakener.
Activate Hourglass of the Lost's first ability by tapping it, adding {W} and putting a time counter on it.
Kate's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat from step 2.
1636-2734-5371-7629.notes: Since Hourglass of the Lost will get infinite time counters, Kate Stewart's second ability can be used to make your creatures infinitely large.

4613-4927-5310-5477-5627.easyPrerequisites: There is a land card in your library.
4613-4927-5310-5477-5627.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature other than Bloodghast that is untapped and that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4613-4927-5310-5477-5627.description:
Activate a creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it by tapping it and sacrificing Bloodghast, searching your library for a land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Repeat using the Plant instead until no lands are in your library.

2232-2459-3558.description:
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
When Crookshank Kobolds enters. Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Rograkh from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
When Rograkh enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3899-6441-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

5702-6202-6753.easyPrerequisites: You control a Forest that enters the battlefield untapped.
5702-6202-6753.notablePrerequisites: You have an instant or sorcery card in hand with mana to cast it.
5702-6202-6753.description:
Animate a Forest that enters untapped using Noyan Dar
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
When the Forest tokens enter, Springheart Nantuko triggers twice.
Holding priority, activate the Forest tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of the Forest that enters untapped.
Repeat from step 4.

1995-3918-7013.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four creatures that share a creature type.

uses.n: Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel

821-5220-6578-6900.description:
Activate Mogg Fanatic by sacrificing it.
When Mogg Fanatic dies, Mortuary and Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Mogg Fanatic from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER // Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Mogg Fanatic ability.
Cast Mogg Fanatic from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.
821-5220-6578-6900.notes: Whether Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER or Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel is on the battlefield, the combo will function, either by using Sephiroth, Fabled SOLDIER's ability or the ability from Sephiroth, One-Winged Angel's emblem.

1978-3488-4306.notablePrerequisites: Your devotion to any color is at least three.
1978-3488-4306.description:
Animate Nyx Lotus using Katsumasa.
Activate Nyx Lotus by tapping it, adding at least {3}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Nyx Lotus.
Repeat from step 2.

972-2556-2792.easyPrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}.
972-2556-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is an artifact.
When the Great Whale token enters, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Cast Mnemonic Wall by paying its mana cost.
When Mnemonic Wall enters, it triggers, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}.
Cast Saheeli's Artistry by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mnemonic Wall and the Great Whale token.
When the Mnemonic Wall and Great Whale tokens enter, they trigger.
Resolve the Mnemonic Wall token's trigger, returning Saheeli's Artistry from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat from step 6.
972-2556-2792.notes: If the seven lands can tap to produce {5}{U}{U} or more, this combo will net infinite mana. So long as you produce an extra {U} each loop, you can eventually stop copying Great Whale and copy other creature(s) or artifact(s) instead. You can also create two copies of Mnemonic Wall instead to return other applicable cards to your hand.

826-1308-4508-5880.description:
Activate Amoeboid Changeling by tapping it, causing Magmaw to gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat from step 2.

725-5256-6478-6730.notablePrerequisites: There are at least X counters on artifacts, creatures and/or enchantments you control, where X is 3 plus the number of times you've cast Sin from the command zone this game.
725-5256-6478-6730.description:
Cast Sin either from your hand or command zone by paying {5}{G}{U} plus commander tax if applicable.
As Sin enters, remove all counters from all artifacts, enchantments and creatures you control, putting twice that many +1/+1 counters on Sin.
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {U} equal to Sin's toughness.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping Sin, untapping Arbor Adherent.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Sin.
Choose to return Sin to the command zone from your graveyard.
When Sin dies, it triggers, putting its counters on Arbor Adherent.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat.

372-2974-3556.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Flicker.
372-2974-3556.description:
Cast Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Flicker.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

81-1323-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Kami of Whispered Hopes's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1479-5233-6662.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5233-6662.description:
Play Boros Garrison.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it, Chocobo Racetrack, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Boros Garrison trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Boros Garrison from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Boros Garrison enters the battlefield, it and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

2882-5256-6603.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2882-5256-6603.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2882-5256-6603.description:
Cause a nontoken creature to enter the battlefield under your control, which enters as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial due to Infinite Reflection.
When the creature enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the creature's trigger, putting a creature card from an opponent's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control as a copy of Sepulchral Primordial.
Repeat from step 2.

2084-6512.description:
Cast See Double by paying {2}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Mirror-Mad Phantasm.
Activate the Mirror-Mad Phantasm token by paying {1}{U}, shuffling the token into your library and milling your entire library due to it not having a card named Mirror-Mad Phantasm in it.

509-662-1267-4883.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{R} available the first turn, with {4} each extra turn
509-662-1267-4883.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
509-662-1267-4883.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Medomai the Ageless.
Medomai the Ageless triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Liquimetal Coating by tapping it, causing Medomai the Ageless to become an artifact.
Cast Idris by paying {1}{U}{R}.
When Idris enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Medomai the Ageless until Idris leaves the battlefield.
Move to your extra turn.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Idris's vanishing ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Activate Contagion Clasp by paying {4} and tapping it, putting a time counter on Idris.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Idris.
Idris triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat from step 6.

549-1365-2438-4853--20.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent was dealt damage this turn.
The creature with bloodthirst does not have a -1/-1 counter on it.
549-1365-2438-4853--20.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving the creature with bloodthirst persist until end of turn.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the creature with bloodthirst.
When the creature dies, its persist ability and Dross Scorpion trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield, which enters the battlefield with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to its bloodthirst ability.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1418-3487-4374.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two energy counters.
1418-3487-4374.description:
Activate Aethergeode Miner by paying {E}{E}, blinking it.
When Aethergeode Miner enters the battlefield, Aetherstorm Roc triggers twice, causing you to get {E}{E}.
Repeat.

2532-2534-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Jaxis does not have summoning sickness.
You have at least one card in hand.
2532-2534-5231.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Coercive Recruiter with haste.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Jaxis.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Coercive Recruiter token, adding {R}.
When the Coercive Recruiter token dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

224-1361-3281-4096.notablePrerequisites: Goblin Welder does not have summoning sickness.
224-1361-3281-4096.description:
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Great Furnace and return Ancient Den from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Ancient Den enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Ancient Den by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Goblin Welder by tapping it, causing you to sacrifice Ancient Den and return Great Furnace from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Great Furnace enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Goblin Welder.
Activate Great Furnace by tapping it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

2232-3416-4050.notablePrerequisites:
You control a nontoken, nonartifact Vampire that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have a nonartifact Vampire card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana.
You have enough mana to cast the Vampire in hand.
2232-3416-4050.description:
Cast the nonartifact Vampire from your hand by paying its mana cost.
Edgar triggers, creating a 1/1 Vampire creature token.
The nontoken Vampire enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning any other nontoken, nonartifact Vampire that can be cast using one colored mana from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Vampire token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1651-1737-3281-3698.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by paying {0} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Furnace.
The Great Furnace token enters, triggering Grinding Station, untapping Grinding Station.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Great Furnace token and Grinding Station, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.
